correctness.rationale: Two independent standalone checkers were run successfully. The structural proof classifies four-covers and reduces reconfiguration to a 40-object finite graph. The explicit incidence lemma checks every one of 780 unordered pairs; all 1600 BFS profiles independently checked directly from Q5. The eight-vertex minimum follows from parity class coverage, not enumeration. Potential code/translation errors were checked with independent full-domain algorithms. Results are exact for Q5 only.

value.rationale: One simultaneous change cannot preserve optimal total domination, but two simultaneous changes suffice to reach every other optimal configuration in at most four steps; the exact 24-regular mobility graph specifies all intermediate feasible optima. This sharp threshold and metric are substantively motivated by reconfiguration of optimal coverage resources, and not reducible to a routine static enumeration.
